content: Umeed Education System is located in Lahore and provides education from Playgroup through Class 10, including a Hifz section.
The official general contact number is 0300-4117086 and the official email address is umeededusys@gmail.com.
The annual fund is PKR 2,400 for a new admission and PKR 2,150 for a student promoted to the next class. The assistant must state both categories or ask which category applies.
The standard monthly tuition reference is PKR 2,000. Hifz, Class 9 and Class 10 use the current prospectus amount and should be confirmed against the latest approved fee document before publication.
Admissions information covers Playgroup through Class 10 and the Hifz section. Admission availability and final placement remain subject to school confirmation.
